panels.title: Q1 · K2 first visible output p95 by runner protocol · warm Slack

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(t.sent_at) AS time, if(p.protocol = '', 'v3', p.protocol) AS protocol, quantileIf(0.95)(t.first_visible_ms, t.outcome != 'silent') AS p95
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND path = 'warm' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT turn_id, trace_id, multiIf(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4 AND JSONExtractUInt(data, 'api_clients') > 0, 'v4+client', JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4, 'v4', 'v3') AS protocol FROM calvin_events WHERE event_name = 'turn.started' AND turn_id != '' AND occurred_at >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND occurred_at < $__toTime + INTERVAL 1 HOUR LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS p ON p.turn_id = t.turn_id GROUP BY time, protocol ORDER BY time
